finalists.Name: temporal_cohort_selection_audit
finalists.Title: The Future Chooses the Test Set: Auditing Temporal Selection Leakage in Recommendation Benchmarks
finalists.gap_addressed: Zhao et al. document inconsistent core filtering and altered model rankings; Time to Split documents evaluation-protocol dependence. Isolating future-conditioned cohort selection is an inferred extension of these documented limitations.
finalists.Experiment: Use raw Amazon Beauty ratings and MovieLens 1M. Fix historical training, validation, and test windows. Append records after the test window solely for computing full-timeline k-cores. Compare train-only filtering. Run a 2x2 training-mask/evaluation-cohort factorial with a fixed historical candidate catalog, four CPU recommenders, two cutoffs, three suffix lengths, and k=0/5 plus k=2 sensitivity. Measure cohort retention and model-comparison changes with paired user bootstrap intervals.

finalists.Name: log_cache_error_persistence_audit
finalists.Title: Silent Cache Hits: Measuring Error Persistence and Delayed Event Discovery in LLM Log Parsing
finalists.gap_addressed: SoK: LLM-based Log Parsing explicitly discusses initially incorrect stored templates. The proposed narrower gap is persistence through accepted cache hits and delayed discovery of labeled event families.
finalists.Experiment: Replay Linux, Mac, and Hadoop from Loghub-2.0. Instrument cache-hit/miss paths in EFParser and SCOPE and compare Drain. Use native order where meaningful and explicitly synthetic late-family-arrival orderings as stress tests. Separate naturally occurring errors from injected-cache-error sensitivity tests. Compare random and novelty-token audit selection at matched audit budgets, with labels used only for offline scoring. Measure cumulative false hits, family-discovery delay, group F1, parsing accuracy, and token cost.

finalists.Name: projection_heatmap_locality_audit
finalists.Title: Local Colors, Global Dependencies: Auditing Projection-Distortion Heatmaps
finalists.gap_addressed: The July 2026 Gap Index discusses relative/raw-area interpretability and describes local point influence. Its global area normalization motivates an explicit audit of untouched-region score changes under remote boundary perturbations.
finalists.Experiment: Analyze the sum-normalized Gap Index and its max-normalized 2025 precursor. Derive local-geometry versus global-normalization contributions. Use Digits and a fixed Fashion-MNIST subset with PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP. Move small boundary subsets while preserving original interior geometry; score common unchanged triangles with fixed and recomputed triangulations. Compare original, raw-area, and reference-calibrated diagnostics. Include genuine local-gap deformations and rigid-motion controls. No human-perception claims.
